details.flavorMarkdown: *A clear humanoid construct filled with shifting reflections and seams of colored glass. It was made to watch magical boundaries and protect a specific object.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Cutting reflection

**Target:** One visible creature within 5 squares. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** radiant.

### Spell Screen

Before one spell against it resolves, impose 1 Bane on that player attack (or give its controller 1 defense Boon). For one player AoE roll, include this when choosing worst-case modifiers. Does not cancel the spell.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Lifeless Body:** does not breathe or eat; only the listed immunities apply.

**Healing:** Construct: ordinary HP healing does not repair it; destroyed at 0. Combat repair requires an explicit repair ability. Workshop repair remains a design question.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** A faint musical note sounds when magic crosses the threshold.

**Purpose:** Keep magic away from a protected object.

**Tactics and retreat:** Screen a spell and drive a caster away from the object with cutting light.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Move the object through a mundane route or exploit the sentinel’s literal instructions.

**Habitat:** Vault; observatory · **Communication:** Repeats its command in the maker’s language

**Loot:** Colored glass salvage worth 12 coins from the original body.

**Summoning:** Construct 3 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/bestiary/summons/glass-sentinel.md).

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-glass-sentinel


**Category:** Construct · **Role:** Spell guard · **CV:** 15

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

**Reference damage:** 3/4/6

**Reference type:** radiant

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.25

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.404, O=4.162. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md), [spell screen](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/spell-screen.md).
